final: WITH race_stats AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) as avg_points, COUNT(*) as count FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(count) as overall_avg_count FROM race_stats), filtered_stats AS (SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.count, oa.overall_avg_count FROM race_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rs.count > oa.overall_avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_points) as avg_of_avg_points, AVG(count) as avg_of_counts, AVG(count - overall_avg_count) as avg_excess FROM filtered_stats
